name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Classicsaunaproducts.com is owned and operated by J & M Decorations, Inc. - a San Francisco Bay area company that specializes in very high quality teak furniture for your home, garden, patio or deck. J & M Decorations, Inc. was founded in 1999 and our first retail online store www.ClassicTeak.com was opened the same year. Here at Classicsaunaproducts.com you will find a large selection and variety of high quality saunas and spas.



We are authorized dealers of the products we sell so you know you you are dealing with a company you can trust and rely on. We have been in business since 1999 and offer only the highest quality products from top manufacturers like Viking Spas, Sauna King and of course our own line of Grade A Teak products.



If you are considering buying a sauna or spa, we offer free consultation. Please feel free to call us and ask us any question about our products. Our dedicated staff is always ready to answer your questions. Apart from residences, we also work with designers and sell directly to commercial locations like restaurants, hotels, golf clubs and churches. Please feel free to contact us for for your commercial needs.
